diagnosis_explanation:
Schizoaffective disorder is a condition that affects your mood and how you think. It can cause changes in your mood. You might feel very happy or energetic. You might also feel very sad or have low energy. This condition can also affect your thoughts. You may sometimes have thoughts that are not based in reality. This is called psychosis. Your doctor will help you manage these symptoms.

Hepatitis C is a liver infection. It is caused by a virus. This virus can spread through blood. Hepatitis C can sometimes cause liver damage. Your doctor will discuss treatment options with you.
medication_rationale:
Seroquel 25 mg nightly:
This medicine helps to calm your mind. It can help with mood swings and seeing or hearing things that are not there. You might feel a bit sleepy after taking it. You might also feel a little dizzy or have a dry mouth. Call your doctor if you feel very restless or have jerky movements.

Zyprexa 5 mg twice daily:
This medicine helps to improve your mood and thinking. It is used for mood swings and seeing or hearing things that are not there. You may feel sleepy or tired. Your mouth might feel dry. Call your doctor if you have a high fever or feel very stiff.

Risperdal M-Tab 2 mg twice daily - stopping:
Your doctor wants you to stop taking this medicine. It was making you feel too restless. Do not take it until your doctor tells you it is safe to start again.
recovery_trajectory:
**Week 1:**
- You might feel confused or have trouble thinking clearly.
- Stick to a simple daily routine.
- Eat regular meals.
- Try to get some sleep at the same time each night.
- It is okay to ask for help with tasks.
- Call your doctor if your thoughts become very disorganized.
- Call your doctor if you have thoughts of hurting yourself.

**Week 2:**
- You may start to feel a bit more clear headed.
- Focus on one task at a time.
- Continue to eat balanced meals.
- Try to spend a little time outdoors each day.
- Talk to a trusted friend or family member.
- Call your doctor if you feel much more confused.
- Call your doctor if you have trouble sleeping.

**Week 3:**
- Your thinking may become more organized this week.
- Try to do one small chore or activity each day.
- Keep your eating and sleeping schedule steady.
- Spend time with people who make you feel comfortable.
- Your goal this week is to make a simple to-do list.
- Call your doctor if your mood changes suddenly.
- Call your doctor if you hear voices that are not there.

**Week 4:**
- You should feel more in control of your thoughts.
- You can try taking on slightly more complex tasks.
- Continue with healthy eating and sleeping habits.
- Consider joining a support group or activity.
- Your goal this week is to stick to your daily routine.
- Call your doctor if you feel a loss of energy.
- Call your doctor if you feel very irritable.

**When to expect improvement:**
- Thinking and feeling more organized takes time.
- Keep working on your daily routines.
- Talking to your doctor can help manage symptoms.
- Healing is a step-by-step process.
escalation_guide:
CALL 911 IMMEDIATELY
These symptoms are life-threatening. Do not drive yourself.
- You are a danger to yourself: Harm yourself right now.
- You are a danger to others: Harm others right now.

GO TO THE ER TODAY
Do not wait until tomorrow. Go within a few hours.
- You are hearing voices: Voices are telling you to harm yourself.
- You cannot care for yourself: You cannot eat or bathe yourself.
- You feel you are going to hurt someone: Harm to others may happen.

CALL YOUR DOCTOR
Call during office hours. Do not go to the ER for these.
- You are hearing voices: Voices do not tell you to harm anyone.
- You feel you are acting strange: Others notice changes in you.
- You feel you are going to harm yourself: You will not act on it.
- Questions about your medicine: Your nurse can help you plan.
